scope: Generated-pixel native H.264 regression; no desktop capture, user screen permissions, or Reach runtime.
cause: With Swift 6.1.2 -O, passing the conditional self-test/normal argument array into Capture selected video=false and strictHardware=false for --self-test. It emitted JPEG where the test required framed H.264. Separate initializer calls in explicit branches preserve the requested format.
fix: Construct Capture in separate self-test and normal branches.
Fail the H.264 self-test explicitly unless video and strictHardware are both enabled.
Check normal initialized video/hardware flags against the requested arguments; preserve intentional JPEG mode.

before.observedFailure: Uninstrumented -O output began ffd8ffdb (JPEG) rather than the bounded JSON metadata length; self-test/emit instrumentation reported video=false, strictHardware=false.
before.crossHostProof: The hash-verified hosted binary also failed the guarded generated-pixel test on a different local Mac; local Swift 6.3 builds passed.

comparisons.note: Instrumentation changed optimization; not accepted as the fix.

comparisons.variant: Normal positional H.264 arguments with generated pixels, -O

validation: Exact final source compiled with the same hosted Swift 6.1.2 -O and passed the strict native test.
Generated key/frame/frame/key commands produced bounded JSON metadata, avc1 codec, 640x360 dimensions and the expected true/false/false/true keyframe flags.
Annex B keyframes contained SPS, PPS and IDR NALs; interframes contained a non-IDR slice and no IDR.
Instrumented optimized and unoptimized variants also passed; no fallback or skip accepted.
A configuration-only helper checked normal h264/jpeg modes with hardware/auto arguments (four combinations).
The final source also passed the guarded local native test: one passed, zero skipped.
limits: This proves format selection and NAL framing, not pixel-accurate decoder rendering.
It does not exercise physical screen capture, screen permissions, network streaming, or phone playback.
The complete integrated candidate still needs its normal hosted CI lanes.
